text:
kevin: Heads-up — Azura Systems (contact Lina) wants special billing: post-pay monthly invoicing, net45, a soft usage cap at $25k/mo for the Q3 pilot with automatic one-off credits if they spike, and a 15% intro volume discount for the first 6 months. They're ready to sign today if we can confirm terms. need finance + legal ok.

maria: do we have their historical usage / commit or is this purely pilot? exposure if they blow past the cap? :eyes:

kevin: pilot only. estimated initial run-rate ~$12k/mo, expected growth to $30-40k/mo by month 6 if product-market fit. no commit but customer asks to avoid prepaid for procurement reasons.

sophie: credit risk note — net45 + post-pay for a new mid-market account with no commit is higher exposure. recommend: either require a refundable security deposit equal to 1 month projected usage or limit net terms to net30 for first 3 invoices. also need billing contact + PO# on file.

raj: legal flag — anything with auto-credit logic needs clause on dispute resolution and clear definition of "soft usage cap". if we allow credits, we should cap cumulative credits (e.g., one-time credit up to $5k) and require written approval for additional exceptions. also need to confirm jurisdiction and MSA signature flow.

lina: procurement asked for net45 due to internal AP cycle. they can't do prepay. can do a 6-month pilot SOW and then evaluate. happy to accept a refundable deposit.

kevin: quick pricing blurb I'm proposing to send:

```
Q3 Pilot (6 months):
- Intro volume discount: 15% off list on usage-based charges for first 6 months
- Soft cap: $25,000/month. If usage > $25k in a month, we apply a one-time automatic credit equal to the overage up to $5k, then bill remainder.
- Billing: monthly invoice, Net45 (pilot). Refundable security deposit: $12,000 (applied to final invoice or refunded after pilot termination).
- Requirement: signed SOW + PO; MSA governs terms; disputes handled per MSA Section 6.
```

sophie: i'd tweak — change net45 to net30 for first two invoices, then escalate to net45 if payments on time. keep deposit. drop auto-credit cap to $3k, otherwise exposure heavy.

maria: what revenue threshold triggers exec signoff? if this is >$100k recognized in 12 months we need VP finance + legal signoff. estimate here is borderline but could exceed with upsell. recommend require CFO/VP signoff before committing to 15% discount.

kevin: understood. if we drop discount to 10% and keep deposit + net30 then risk is acceptable? i can push that with the customer.

raj: acceptable path: 10% intro discount, refundable deposit $12k, net30 for first two invoices then net45, auto-credit capped $3k, written SOW referencing MSA credit/dispute clause. i can draft SOW language.

invoice-bot: invoice-12345 generated for Azura Systems (pilot deposit) — status: pending payment.

maria: approve in principle with conditions above. require raj to add SOW clause and require kevin to collect PO + deposit receipt before provisioning. raj/cfo to sign off on discount >10% or >$100k exposure.

kevin: thanks — i'll update the customer and push to 10% with the deposit and collect PO now. will tag when deposit hits. :thumbsup:

lina: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. i'll expedite PO with procurement.

maria: tagging for follow-up: @raj please drop the SOW snippet when ready; @kevin ping finance once deposit is received.
